mapper.sql: promotionals.id AS id, promotionals.title AS title, promotionals.description AS description, promotionals.promotion_type AS promotionType, promotionals.branch_id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, promotionals.`start` AS startDate, promotionals.`end` AS endDate, promotionals.apply_to AS applyTo, promotionals.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, promotionals.modified AS modified, CONCAT(editor.first_name, ' ', editor.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM promotionals LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = promotionals.branch_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = promotionals.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS editor ON editor.id = promotionals.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT promotional_details.id AS id, promotional_details.product_request_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, promotional_details.uom_request AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, promotional_details.qty_free AS qtyFree, promotional_details.qty_promo AS discountQty, promotional_details.discount_percent AS discountPercent, promotional_details.discount_amount AS discountAmount, promotional_details.price AS specialPrice FROM promotional_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = promotional_details.product_request_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = promotional_details.uom_request WHERE promotional_details.promotional_id = #{promotionalId}

SELECT promotional_sub_details.id AS id, promotional_sub_details.product_request_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, promotional_sub_details.uom_request AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, promotional_sub_details.qty AS qty FROM promotional_sub_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = promotional_sub_details.product_request_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = promotional_sub_details.uom_request WHERE promotional_sub_details.promotional_detail_id = #{promotionalDetailId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotionals ( title, description, promotion_type, branch_id, `start`, `end`, apply_to, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{promotional.title}, #{promotional.description}, #{promotional.promotionType}, #{promotional.branchId}, #{promotional.startDate}, #{promotional.endDate}, #{promotional.applyTo}, NOW(), #{promotional.createdBy}, #{promotional.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE promotionals SET title = #{promotional.title}, description = #{promotional.description}, promotion_type = #{promotional.promotionType}, branch_id = #{promotional.branchId}, `start` = #{promotional.startDate}, `end` = #{promotional.endDate}, apply_to = #{promotional.applyTo}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{promotional.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{promotional.id} AND status > 0
UPDATE promotionals SET status = 0, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotional_details ( promotional_id, uom_request, product_request_id, qty_free, qty_promo, discount_percent, discount_amount, price ) VALUES ( #{detail.promotionalId}, #{detail.uomId}, #{detail.productId}, #{detail.qtyFree}, #{detail.discountQty}, #{detail.discountPercent}, #{detail.discountAmount}, #{detail.price} )
